test.//dependsOn: No `build` dependency: the resource-consuming suites that read this project's OWN build (dist-artifact-smoke spawns dist/index.mjs) were extracted into sibling `*.e2e.ts` files (see their `*.spec.ts` stubs) and now run only under the opt-in `e2e` target. No remaining default-lane spec reads dist/, so the default target no longer builds before testing. targetDefaults.test still contributes `^build` (dependency builds) + `lint`.

e2e.//: Resource-consuming lane: runs ONLY the `*.e2e.ts` suites extracted out of the default `test` target (the CPU-heavy real ts-morph/TypeScript compilation suites, plus two spawnSync subprocess specs). Opt-in and deliberately NOT wired into any `test.dependsOn` nor into nx.json `targetDefaults`, so `nx affected -t test` / the pre-commit + pre-push hooks never reach it. `dependsOn: ["build"]` because the moved suite spawns the shipped `dist/index.mjs`. Its coverage dir is DISTINCT from the default lane's, and declares no dist-shaped output.
